g.text: Two encoder motors, four servo ports, IMU
A classroom robot designed and built in Zambia. The RoboCore V2 controller puts an ESP32-S3 with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, two
encoder motor drives, four servo ports, a motion sensor and sockets for line and ultrasonic sensing on one board, running from
a single lithium cell with USB-C charging. The robot arrives assembled; the arm module bolts on in minutes.
Two encoder motors, four servo ports, IMU

RoboCore V2 robot, assembled, with controller, HC-SR04 ultrasonic, 3-channel line sensor and battery holder · Arm module: base, boom, claw, 2 micro servos, 2 ballast clips · USB-C cable · Screw and nut pack ·
Quick-start card. 18650 cells and the M8 ballast nuts are not included.
Controller RoboCore V2, ESP32-S3, 68 x 60 mm
Power 1S Li-ion, 3 x 18650 in parallel, USB-C charging
Drive 2 x TT encoder motors, 56 mm wheels, 2 casters
Sensing 3-channel line sensor, HC-SR04 ultrasonic, IMU
Robot 167 x 166 x 65 mm, about 540 g with the arm
Box 273 x 203 x 83 mm, E-flute card
Not a toy. Contains small parts and screws: not for children under 8. Use only 1S lithium cells; charge through
USB-C under supervision. Keep metal away from the antenna.
CLASSROOM ROBOT · REV 2.0 · DESIGNED IN ZAMBIA
A robot a class can build, program and repair
OUTSIDE. RoboCore V2 mailer box, roll-end tuck-top, outer 273 x 203 x 83 mm, E-flute 1.5 mm. Print 1:1; navy solid = cut, grey dashed = fold. Bar = 100 mm.
